referenceText: there's currently 6 games in development for bendy. two of which are cage and batif. cage having the priority at the moment, while batif remains in our internal version pre-production where we continuously discuss the game but don't implement anything as that time is slated for cage. the remaining titles are either outsourced or already developed, we're in no rush with these projects, we want to take our time and do things the best we can. also because there's a number of other projects in mind that we want to wait for the right time and/or team. aside from the games, we're still deep in development on the movie, which is in an exciting phase right now. i'm still on the hunt for both 2d and 3d animation studios to work with on various series, yes both. and we're also working on some other bendy collabs and stuff, primarily products more so than games. There's currently only 1 game related collab that's in talks, and has been for a while, and probably the only one we'll entertain until something intriguing comes along. in any event, this long winded post is just me giving you all a random update on things being worked on, and is also by no means confirming anything, but I'm sure dots that don't exist will be connected :P Take this as your average update from mike saying "yup, still working on lots of stuff with nothing to show" as is typical fashion here at Joey Drew Studios. Also for what it's worth, unit sales of all bendy games have increased, even without discounts active, so there's still waves of new audiences yet to experience Bendy. and hopefully soon this year new players will get the best experience once our updates come out for all the games on all platforms.
